name: Psychics
overview: Scripture clearly condemns involvement with psychics, familiar spirits, and witchcraft, warning believers not to seek guidance from such sources as they defile and lead away from God’s commands (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6). The Old Testament prescribes severe judgment against those who practice or consult these occult arts, including death (Leviticus 20:27). The New Testament recounts examples of sorcery and spirit possession used to deceive and exploit others, demonstrating that these practices persist and are contrary to the gospel (Acts 8:9; 16:16). Believers are called to reject all forms of divination and witchcraft, remaining faithful to God alone (Deuteronomy 18:9).
